name: Locus
description: One prepaid balance for agents to find, price and call pay-per-use APIs, data and tools, under spending caps, via MCP, CLI or HTTP. Also offers a USDC agent wallet on Base. YC-backed.

skills.name: Call Paid APIs
skills.description: Searches the Locus catalog, checks a tool's price and calls it with a credit cap, paying from one prepaid balance.

skills.name: Set Agent Spend Limits
skills.description: Caps agent spend with a monthly hard limit, per-request limits, approvals for new tools, auto-reload and email alerts.

skills.name: Run Paid Tasks
skills.description: Turns a plain-language goal into a checked result with files and exact cost, within a credit ceiling, or saves it as a Workflow.

skills.name: Hold Funds in Agent Wallet
skills.description: Gives an agent an on-chain USDC wallet on Base to send payments and pay x402 and wrapped API calls.
